$comment: Junior Architect Pipeline task map, v2. One entry per junior task: family, RIBA stages (AIA and HOAI in 'stages'), autonomy ceiling, agent, skill, deterministic checker and its inputs, the hosts it works in and the capabilities it needs from them (described in plain words, so any MCP server that provides them can be used), the judgement step the junior keeps, and the failure modes. Hooks, scripts/jap.js and the commands read this file. Edit it to fit your office.

autonomy_levels.A0: The junior does the task. The agent stays silent unless asked a question.
autonomy_levels.A1: The agent drafts only after the junior has written a prediction. The junior rewrites or approves every line.
autonomy_levels.A2: The agent executes. Deterministic checks gate the output. The junior reviews the redline and accepts or rejects each item with a reason.
autonomy_levels.A3: The agent executes and checks. The junior signs off a sample of at least 20% of items.
autonomy_levels.A4: Fully automatic. Not used for any task in this map by default.

brief-digest.inputs: the client brief as plain text (brief.txt, extracted from the PDF)
brief-digest.junior_keeps: Before reading the digest, rank the three requirements that will drive the plan and say why.
failure_modes: requirement paraphrased into a different meaning

site-dossier.inputs: site sources (survey, cadastre extract, planning portal pages) saved as text (site.txt)
site-dossier.junior_keeps: Predict the two site constraints that will matter most, then check them against the dossier.
capabilities: fetch open map data (buildings, streets) for the site

site-model.inputs: the parcel boundary and survey or terrain source; site_rules.json with the surveyed parcel area, levels and north angle
site-model.junior_keeps: Write the parcel area, the level difference across the site and true north before the model is built.
failure_modes: true north and project north confused
terrain from a coarse dataset presented as survey
parcel traced from the wrong source
capabilities: create layers to the office standard
import open map data (buildings, streets, parcels)
build terrain from survey points or a terrain dataset

code-research.inputs: the question and the code documents in force as plain text (codes/*.txt) with editions in project.json
code-research.junior_keeps: Predict the governing clause and its threshold before the search; explain any disagreement with the agent's result.

planning-constraints.inputs: the parcel and the zoning and planning documents as plain text (codes/*.txt)
planning-constraints.junior_keeps: Sketch the buildable envelope by hand first; compare it with the agent's envelope.
failure_modes: height measured from the wrong datum
setback applied to the wrong boundary

buildable-envelope.inputs: the verified planning constraints (planning_constraints.md, checked) turned into envelope_rules.json with a source per rule
buildable-envelope.junior_keeps: Predict the maximum gross floor area the envelope allows before the model computes it.
failure_modes: rule entered without a source clause
height plane from the wrong datum
envelope ignores daylight or angle planes
setback from kerb instead of boundary
capabilities: cut solids with planes (height and angle planes)

regulation-check.inputs: the design model and regulation_rules.json (height, coverage, FAR, setbacks, parking, outdoor space) with sources
regulation-check.junior_keeps: Name the rule you expect the design to fail, and by how much.
failure_modes: measured to a different area standard than the rule
rule paraphrased into a different limit
compliance claimed from an unchecked number
capabilities: measure heights, footprints and floor areas

massing-study.inputs: the brief areas, the buildable envelope and the site model; massing_rules.json (GFA target, height, coverage, FAR, sun to the court)
massing-study.junior_keeps: Sketch two alternative massings by hand and predict which meets the brief with more daylight.
failure_modes: options that differ only in form, not in strategy
GFA counted to the wrong standard
triangular or token forms with no reasoning about access and circulation

bim-setup.inputs: the levels and grids schedule (names, elevations, spacing), the office template and project info
bim-setup.junior_keeps: Write the floor-to-floor heights and structural zone before the levels are created.
failure_modes: levels named against the office convention
grid spacing in the wrong units
types created without materials or layers
capabilities: create wall, floor and roof types with layers

building-model.inputs: the approved plan (sketch, DWG or Rhino plan), the levels and grids, the room targets (targets.csv)
building-model.junior_keeps: Mark on the plan where you expect the model to disagree with the sketch (walls that do not close, rooms that will not bound).
failure_modes: walls that do not join, so rooms will not bound
walls drawn to centreline where the plan measures faces
doors placed in the wrong host or swing
capabilities: link or import a CAD plan
create joined walls, floors, ceilings and roofs
place doors and windows in host walls

stairs-and-cores.inputs: the core layout, floor-to-floor heights and the stair rules of the code in force (set stair_rules in project.json)
stairs-and-cores.junior_keeps: Calculate the number of risers, the riser height and the going by hand from the floor-to-floor height before the stair is modelled.
failure_modes: uneven risers at the top or bottom
headroom clash under the flight above
too many risers in one flight
capabilities: read stair parameters (risers, goings, widths, headroom)

facade-and-curtain-wall.inputs: the facade strategy (module, glazing ratio, panel limits in project.json fabrication)
facade-and-curtain-wall.junior_keeps: Choose the module and predict how many unique panel types it produces.
failure_modes: panels beyond transport or glass-size limits

families.inputs: the family brief: category, parameters, types and naming per the office standard (required_fields.families)
families.junior_keeps: Sketch the family's reference planes and parameters before the agent builds it.
failure_modes: geometry not locked to reference planes, so it breaks on flex
wrong category, so it schedules wrongly
type names off the naming convention
capabilities: create and edit families from templates

grasshopper-definition.inputs: the design rule in words and the inputs it reads from the Rhino model
grasshopper-definition.junior_keeps: Draw the dataflow (inputs, operations, outputs) on paper before the definition is built.
failure_modes: internalised geometry that stops following the model
data trees grafted or flattened by accident
capabilities: solve and read each component's runtime state

fabrication-prep.inputs: the element to fabricate and the stock sheet sizes in project.json fabrication.stock
fabrication-prep.junior_keeps: Predict how many parts and sheets the element needs.
failure_modes: parts larger than the stock sheet

view-set.inputs: the drawing list for the stage (levels, sections, elevations, scales in project.json view_requirements)
view-set.junior_keeps: Mark the section lines on the plan yourself: where a section cuts decides what it explains.
capabilities: create plans per level, sections, elevations, callouts and 3D views

annotation.inputs: the views to annotate and the tag coverage required (project.json tag_coverage)
annotation.junior_keeps: Dimension one plan by hand: which strings a builder needs, in which order.
failure_modes: dimension strings that do not close
capabilities: count tags and dimensions per view

detailing.inputs: the wall, floor and roof build-ups (layers, thicknesses, materials) and the details list
detailing.junior_keeps: Draw the junction by hand first: the line of insulation, the airtight layer, the drainage path.
failure_modes: insulation line broken at the junction
build-up thicknesses differ from the wall type
detail not referenced from the plan
capabilities: create wall sections and drafting views
place detail components, repeating details and insulation
draw filled regions and detail lines

sheet-production.inputs: the drawing list, the title block, the naming convention and status codes in project.json
sheet-production.junior_keeps: Lay out one sheet by hand: what goes where so the drawing reads in order.
failure_modes: views placed at the wrong scale
capabilities: build sheet sets and export PDF

rhino-2d-drawings.inputs: the 3D model, the drawings to extract (plans, sections, elevations) and the CAD standard in project.json cad
rhino-2d-drawings.junior_keeps: Decide the line weights for cut, beyond and below before the drawing is extracted.
failure_modes: Make2D output not cleaned (duplicate and hidden lines)
capabilities: create layers to the CAD standard

dwg-export.inputs: the views or sheets to exchange and the receiving party's CAD standard
dwg-export.junior_keeps: Open the export in a CAD viewer and check one layer and one dimension yourself.
capabilities: export DWG and DXF with a layer mapping

drawing-qa.inputs: the sheet list export (sheets.csv) and the PDFs or the model
drawing-qa.junior_keeps: Accept or reject each redline item with a one-line reason; flag items the checker cannot see.

sheet-register.inputs: the sheet list export from the model (sheets.csv)
sheet-register.junior_keeps: Confirm the revision and status codes of every sheet issued for construction.
failure_modes: status code wrong for the purpose
name not compliant with the naming convention

area-schedule.inputs: the model and the brief targets (targets.csv: room,target_m2)
area-schedule.junior_keeps: Estimate the total and the three largest deviations from the brief before the run.
failure_modes: wrong area definition (centreline versus internal face)
capabilities: read room boundaries as polylines with units

room-data-sheets.inputs: the model and the office room data sheet fields (required_fields.rooms)
room-data-sheets.junior_keeps: Fill one room data sheet by hand per room type, then compare with the agent's.
failure_modes: finishes inconsistent with the room type

door-schedule.inputs: the model and the office door standard (required_fields.doors)
door-schedule.junior_keeps: Explain every deviation from the office door standard (fire rating, width, ironmongery set).
failure_modes: fire rating inconsistent with the wall

window-schedule.inputs: the model and the office window standard (required_fields.windows)
window-schedule.junior_keeps: Check the three windows that carry the most risk (largest, highest, fire or acoustic) by hand.
failure_modes: opening size from the wrong reference

quantity-takeoff.inputs: the model and the cost plan's measurement rules (allowed units per category in project.json quantity_units)
quantity-takeoff.junior_keeps: Estimate the three biggest quantities (facade area, floor area, wall volume) before the takeoff.
failure_modes: takeoff area disagrees with the area schedule
capabilities: read quantities by category and material

viewport-captures.inputs: the views to capture: eye-level, aerial, axonometric, with the purpose of each
viewport-captures.junior_keeps: Choose each camera's position and say what it is meant to show before it is captured.
failure_modes: captures below the resolution the board needs
capabilities: set camera position, target and lens
capture views at a given resolution

sun-shadow-study.inputs: the site latitude, longitude and time zone, and the dates and times required (equinox and solstices are typical)
sun-shadow-study.junior_keeps: Predict which spaces are in shade at 15:00 on the winter solstice before the study runs.
failure_modes: sun not set to the real site and date
capabilities: set the sun from location, date and time

materials.inputs: the material palette with real products, colours and finishes
materials.junior_keeps: Choose the palette with real samples, then compare the rendered colours with the samples.
failure_modes: generic materials left in the model
render colour far from the specified product
capabilities: set texture mapping at true scale
sample colours from a product image

rendering.inputs: the approved cameras, the materials, the site context and the date and time of each view
rendering.junior_keeps: Write what each image must make a viewer understand, then check the render against it.
failure_modes: sun at an impossible position for the site
image sharper or emptier than the place will ever be

photo-match.inputs: a site photograph with its camera position if known, and the model
photo-match.junior_keeps: Mark three fixed points in the photo (a corner, a kerb, a roofline) that the model must line up with.
capabilities: match the camera to a photograph
compare a capture with the photograph

diagrams.inputs: the argument each diagram makes (circulation, structure, program, phasing)
diagrams.junior_keeps: Sketch the diagram's one idea first: one diagram, one argument.
failure_modes: diagram that shows everything and argues nothing

presentation-board.inputs: the checked drawings and images, captions and sources; compose with scripts/board.js
presentation-board.junior_keeps: Lay out the board's reading order on paper: what a reviewer must see first, second, third.
failure_modes: drawings without scale bars or north
text too small at print size

daylight-and-sun.inputs: the model, the daylight and sun requirements of the code in force (daylight_rules.json with sources)
daylight-and-sun.junior_keeps: Predict the three worst-lit rooms before the analysis runs.
failure_modes: window-to-floor ratio used where the code asks for a daylight factor

clash-detection.inputs: the federated model (linked discipline models) and the clash matrix (which categories against which, tolerance)
clash-detection.junior_keeps: Predict the two discipline pairs with the most clashes before the run.
failure_modes: tolerance so tight that noise hides real clashes
capabilities: zoom to and capture clashing elements

model-audit.junior_keeps: Predict the three worst model-health problems before the audit runs.
failure_modes: elements on wrong level or layer

apartment-mix.inputs: the unit plans and the brief's mix and minimum sizes (mix_rules.json)
apartment-mix.junior_keeps: Predict the mix the plan actually achieves before it is counted.
failure_modes: units counted to a different area standard than the brief
dual aspect claimed for single-aspect units
minimum sizes from the wrong standard

ifc-export.inputs: the model, the exchange requirements (schema, required entities) and the counts from the model (expected_counts.json)
ifc-export.junior_keeps: Open the IFC in a free viewer and check one storey and one door by hand.
capabilities: export IFC with a category mapping

spec-section.inputs: the section to write, the standards register (standards_register.csv) and the related schedule
spec-section.junior_keeps: Write the performance clause by hand once per section type before the agent drafts the rest.
failure_modes: product line with no schedule item
prescriptive and performance clauses in conflict

rfi-response.inputs: the RFI text and the current sheet register (sheets.csv)
rfi-response.junior_keeps: Write the intent of the answer in one sentence before the agent words it.
failure_modes: answer changes scope without saying so
contractual commitment the architect cannot give

submittal-review.inputs: the submittal, the specification section and the current sheet register
submittal-review.junior_keeps: List what you expect to be wrong in the submittal before the agent compares it with the specification.

meeting-minutes.junior_keeps: Flag every decision that changes scope, cost or programme.
failure_modes: decision attributed to the wrong person

site-visit-report.junior_keeps: Write your three observations first; then compare with the agent's report of the photos and notes.
failure_modes: defect without an owner or date
